items.title: AI Inference Costs Plummeting
items.summary: GPT-4 class inference costs have fallen 9x-900x in a year, now under $1 per million tokens for some providers.
items.so_what: This drastic cost reduction redefines AI economics, enabling widespread adoption and new business models across all application layers.
